description.value: House of Dosas is a South Indian restaurant at the corner of Kingsway and Knight in Vancouver, a community staple for over 16 years known for its signature dosas — crispy, cylindrical crepes made from fermented rice and lentil batter served with chutneys and curries. The Kingsway flagship operates around the clock every day of the year, making it one of the few full-service restaurant options in Vancouver available to cyclists arriving at any hour. The menu spans dosas, biryanis, curries, and South Indian café drinks, with extensive options for vegan, gluten-free, and omnivore diners.

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 36m; stands (2 spaces) at 47m; stands (2 spaces) at 56m; rack at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 73m; rack at 95m; rack at 97m. Total: 13 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the flagship Kingsway location of a multi-location South Indian restaurant group, with address, phone, and 24/7 status all corroborated. Menu pages use (VG) and (GF) markers throughout and the About Us page explicitly states the restaurant caters to gluten-free and vegan diners. Takeout and pickup ordering are confirmed via 'Order Pick-up & Delivery From Us Directly' on the homepage. No bike-specific amenities (rack, pump, wi-fi, charging) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address omits province and postal code; website gives the more complete '1391 Kingsway Vancouver, BC V5V 3E3' — address_confirmed is true as the street address matches, but the OSM record should be updated with the postal code.

This is a multi-location restaurant group (Kingsway, White Rock, Davie St.); this OSM record covers only the Kingsway flagship. The other two locations are not represented in this OSM node and may warrant separate records.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A long-established, 24/7 full-service restaurant with strong vegetarian, vegan, and GF options and takeout ordering — a practical and welcoming stop for touring cyclists at any hour on a major Vancouver arterial route.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Kingsway location email is management@hodrestaurants.com per the website footer; OSM has no email field populated.
